title: DCGAN Throughput Benchmark: 64x64 Large Batch (B=64, W=64)
intuition: Scales batch size 4x (B=64 at 64x64 RGB) to expose O(B^2) pairwise kernel/transport bottlenecks and batch-scaling memory overhead in critic penalties and prior updates.
failure_mode: Quadratic O(B^2) pairwise distance or transport routines scale poorly as batch size increases from 16 to 64.
protocol_notes: Research diagnostic throughput workload only; no image-quality gate.
